findings_addressed.oracle: Independent oracle: a PowerShell harness extracts the exact production function bodies from service_monitor.ps1 verbatim (Format-Field, Write-ErrorRecord, Write-PipeRecord, Write-JsonlRecord, ConvertTo-StateName, Test-DuplicateTransition, Publish-LifecycleTransition) and calls Publish-LifecycleTransition five times in rapid succession with an identical (service='TestDedup', state='Stopped') synthetic PSCustomObject, then waits 350ms (> 250ms dedup window) and calls it once more. The harness counts JSONL records written to the log file and emits DEDUP_COUNT=N to stdout. The test asserts N == 2: one record from the first burst (the four duplicates are suppressed by Test-DuplicateTransition) and one record after the dedup window expires. The count 2 is computed independently from the JSONL file on disk, not from the call count.
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In service_monitor.ps1 at line 196, remove or comment out 'if (Test-DuplicateTransition -ServiceName $serviceName -State "$EventKind::$stateName") { return }' so that Publish-LifecycleTransition writes a JSONL record on every call without deduplication. Under that mutation all six calls write records, producing DEDUP_COUNT=6, which fails the 'assert actual_count == 2' assertion.

notes: The previously-weak test used a per-state count bound (<= 4) that was too loose to distinguish working dedup from no dedup, because each natural service stop/start cycle only visits each state once so the count never reaches 4 regardless. The re-hardened test replaces the full service stop/start cycle with a synthetic call harness that extracts the production function bodies verbatim (no reimplementation) and directly calls Publish-LifecycleTransition with injected rapid duplicate events within the 250ms window. The JSONL record count of 2 (1 suppressed burst + 1 post-window record) is the independent oracle. The test no longer requires admin privileges or the Spooler service. Verified passing in Docker sandbox (7 passed / 1 skipped for lifecycle test needing admin).
